narrative.overview:
Account linking lives in a small desktop: a pearl menu bar, a bottom dock, and three independent glass windows — Account, Statistics, and Settings. Aqua traffic lights and glossy blue controls bring the old Mac silhouette into the user-approved Frutiger Aero world. Light is the fresh-browser default; optional Dark uses smoked blue with the same wallpaper.

The supplied Asadal landscape is decorative, never a depiction of the real server. The portal still has one practical job: register, sign in, and link an in-game identity. Window controls support that work without changing authentication state.
keyCharacteristics: A menu bar and dock launch Account and Settings.
Aqua window controls, readable glass and sourced Vista artwork.
Truthful account states, keyboard access and responsive windows.

rules.name: Sourced icon rule
rules.body: Use the original user-selected Vista icon artwork and archive-linked Green Aero cursors. Preserve explicit text states, embedded cursor hotspots, and native fallbacks. Never generate replacement icons.

dos: Do preserve desktop window controls, bounds, keyboard alternatives and mobile focus/scroll activation.
Do default fresh or invalid preferences to Light while preserving explicit Dark/System choices.
Do retain sourced artwork attribution, reduced motion, labels and semantic states.
Do use real server-backed account data and preserve loading/error feedback.
donts: Don't reintroduce pixel-font, dirt, wood, or Minecraft sprite chrome into the current interface.
Don't use the decorative scene as evidence about the server world.
Don't invent player counts, balances, activity, a server brand, or navigation to unfinished features.
Don't turn status into color alone: retain the linked/not-linked text and distinct lamp symbols.
